name: One Week With You
source:
We are in war, but in this hard times I can find a peaceful place with you. A adult love history with magic and fantasy like always.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1785160/One_Week_With_You/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我们正处于战争之中，但在这艰难的时刻，我可以和你一起找到一个宁静的地方。一如既往的充满魔法和幻想的成人爱情史。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1785160/One_Week_With_You/]Steam[/url]]
